matched_randomness: route start draws are SHA256-keyed by topology/seed/tick/principal, independent of mode and imitation; adoption draws use a separate keyed stream
deadline: none; p95 is nearest-rank over completed end-to-end tick latencies; all queued/in-service unfinished tasks are counted separately
decision: PASS_METHOD_SCOPED only if both topologies and both imitation values each have a shared_1 p95 reversal in >=3/4 paired seeds and no reversal in no-imitation, shared_24, or per-principal controls; NO_REVERSAL_IN_GRID if primary reversals are zero; otherwise METHOD_FAIL_OR_INCONCLUSIVE
scope: synthetic mechanism/sensitivity only; no empirical adoption, workload elasticity, task mix, verifier capacity, runtime, safety, user, or product inference
